schema.deliberatelyEmptyTable: contacts — the single source of truth is flutter_secure_storage key emergency_contacts_v1
schema.constraintStrategy: column-level NOT NULL/PRIMARY KEY plus validation at the Dart boundary. SQLite CHECK constraints are deliberately absent: a failed CHECK raises inside an insert on the safety timeline, and the emergency path must degrade rather than throw.
schema.transactionBoundary: the 100-row crash-log cap is enforced on every insert; the insert+prune pair is the only genuine multi-statement write
schema.isolationLevel: sqflite serialises through a single native connection per database handle, so the effective isolation is SERIALIZABLE. There is no second writer: no backend, no sync, one process.
schema.migrationStyle: additive only — ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN / CREATE TABLE

map tiles.key: z/x/y tile coordinate — the only cache with a real key space
map tiles.ttl: library default; tiles are immutable for a given z/x/y
map tiles.invalidation: eviction by the tile provider, never by this app
map tiles.stalenessAcceptable: a month-old street tile is still the street

SharedPreferences.ttl: none — this is durable state, not a cache

cache.stampedeRisk: none: there is no shared origin to stampede. The only network cache is per-tile against a public tile server, fetched by one process on one device, and the emergency path performs zero network I/O.

files.exifRisk: none reachable: the app captures, stores and uploads no images. There is no camera permission and no image picker dependency, so there is no EXIF payload to strip.

appsec.sastGap: no taint-analysis SAST (Semgrep/CodeQL) runs on this repository; the linters above are pattern and type checks, not dataflow analysis. Recorded as the measured limit, not restated as coverage.

secrets.keystorePolicy: korubeni_keystore_release.jks is never committed; key.properties is in the secret-quarantine category
secrets.secretManager: GitHub Actions encrypted secrets. There is no cloud secret manager because there is no server: the only secrets are a billing publishable key and a build-time encryption key, both injected at compile time. A KMS would be a system to run, not a risk removed.

exclusions.why: it is kept EMPTY by design; constraints on a table with no rows protect nothing, and resurrecting it is forbidden

negativeControl.mutation: a hard-coded API key and a DROP TABLE on activity_events
